affinity: Logical processor 14; no frequency lock performed or verified
timing: 7 interleaved rounds, median ns per arithmetic input. No game code timing. Loading/hashing overhead shared by all methods.
inputs: All methods receive identical precomputed 64-bit integer ages and frame periods; rates limited to 12/24/30; every timed sample asserts quotient <=1 and checks if/while against division. Exact endpoint cases separately verified.
machine_code: if_single uses SUB, CMP and conditional MOV; while_subtract uses CMP, SUB, INC and conditional backward branch. Actual measured executable checked with linker map.
interpretation: No universal while-versus-if penalty. Almost equal on mixed <=1-frame 30Hz inputs on this CPU/compiler; do not extrapolate absolute times to full Reanimation, another CPU or ARM.
production_changes: None to animation timing or target-FPS limits. 30Hz is a new adaptation target, not yet an implemented minimum.
